title: The Midnight Library
author: Matt Haig
alt: Cover of The Midnight Library by Matt Haig
shortDescription: Between life and death, a library offers Nora Seed the chance to try the lives she might have lived.
detailedDescription: Between life and death there is a library. When Nora Seed finds herself there, each volume gives her a chance to live another version of her life. As she explores what might have been, she must decide what makes a life worth living.

title: Normal People
author: Sally Rooney
alt: Cover of Normal People by Sally Rooney
shortDescription: Connell and Marianne circle one another through school, university and early adulthood.
detailedDescription: Connell and Marianne grow up in the same small Irish town but occupy very different social worlds. Their intense connection follows them from school to university as they test how one person can shape another’s life.

title: The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo
author: Taylor Jenkins Reid
alt: Cover of The Seven Husbands of Evelyn Hugo by Taylor Jenkins Reid
shortDescription: A reclusive Hollywood legend chooses an unknown reporter to tell her life story.
detailedDescription: Aging film icon Evelyn Hugo is finally ready to tell the truth about her glamorous and scandalous life. She unexpectedly selects reporter Monique Grant to write it, revealing ambition, friendship and a great forbidden love.

title: The Silent Patient
author: Alex Michaelides
alt: Cover of The Silent Patient by Alex Michaelides
shortDescription: A psychotherapist becomes determined to learn why a celebrated painter stopped speaking.
detailedDescription: Painter Alicia Berenson shoots her husband and then never speaks another word. Psychotherapist Theo Faber is determined to unravel the mystery of her silence, a pursuit that draws him into his own motivations.

title: A Little Life
author: Hanya Yanagihara
alt: Cover of A Little Life by Hanya Yanagihara
shortDescription: Four college friends navigate ambition, friendship and trauma in New York.
detailedDescription: Four classmates move to New York in search of success, held together by friendship and their devotion to Jude. Across decades, his hidden past and its lasting pain test the limits of love and endurance.

title: The Song of Achilles
author: Madeline Miller
alt: Cover of The Song of Achilles by Madeline Miller
shortDescription: Patroclus recounts his bond with Achilles amid the gathering storm of Troy.
detailedDescription: Exiled prince Patroclus finds an unlikely companion in the brilliant Achilles. Their bond deepens as they train and travel to Troy, where prophecy, honour and war threaten everything they share.

title: It Ends with Us
author: Colleen Hoover
alt: Cover of It Ends with Us by Colleen Hoover
shortDescription: Lily’s new relationship forces her to confront painful patterns from her past.
detailedDescription: Lily has worked hard for the life she wants, and meeting neurosurgeon Ryle seems almost too good to be true. Questions about their relationship and the return of her first love compel her to make a difficult choice.

title: The Housemaid
author: Freida McFadden
alt: Cover of The Housemaid by Freida McFadden
shortDescription: A housemaid discovers that the wealthy family employing her is hiding dangerous secrets.
detailedDescription: Millie is grateful for a fresh start working in the Winchesters’ beautiful home. But behind its locked doors, unsettling behaviour and dangerous secrets turn the job into a tense game in which appearances cannot be trusted.
